title: Screenshot replay video
responsibility: Creates or reuses a cached silent MP4 of the report’s available replay screenshots.

inputs.name: replayVideo.report
inputs.description: Report whose evidence supplies the replay frames: items that are missing, have phase 'before' or are not image media are skipped, and the rest are sorted by order (falling back to array position). The report must yield between 1 and 500 frames or the call rejects.

examples.title: Checkout summary
examples.summary: Checkout summary comparison captured for review.
acceptance: Checkout summary matches the approved design

inputs.name: replayVideo.directory
inputs.description: Report directory that holds the evidence files under assets/ and receives the replays/ cache folder, which is created when missing. A replays entry that is a symbolic link is rejected.

inputs.name: replayVideoKey.report
inputs.description: Report whose replay frames (selected exactly as replayVideo selects them) supply the cache key through each frame's id and file in replay order. replayVideoKey does not apply the 1 to 500 frame limit, so an empty frame list still yields a key.

examples.title: Checkout summary
examples.summary: Checkout summary comparison captured for review.
acceptance: Checkout summary matches the approved design

outputs.name: replayVideoKey
outputs.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest, 64 characters, of the JSON list of each replay frame's [id, file] pair in order plus the fixed ':3s:1280x720:v2' recipe suffix. It names the cached file replays/<key>.mp4, so a change in frame ids, file names, frame order or that suffix produces a different key.

outputs.name: replayVideo
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the path <directory>/replays/<key>.mp4: an existing regular file there is returned as is, otherwise frames are rendered in batches of four, scaled to fit and padded to 1280 by 720, encoded at 10 fps with each screenshot held for three seconds, and renamed into place. The temporary encode folder is removed in finally, and the promise rejects if rendering or encoding fails.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with Error when the report yields no replay frames or more than 500, when the replays folder or the cached MP4 path is a symbolic link, when a screenshot fails to render, or when the video encode exits non-zero. Asset validation errors ('Unregistered asset', 'Invalid asset', 'Invalid asset path'), a missing asset file, a failed ffmpeg spawn and filesystem errors from mkdir, mkdtemp, writeFile, rename or rm also reject.
